name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun delivered 140 leads over 28 days at a $16.01 CPL across $2,241.62 in spend, with Meta carrying all lead volume while Google Ads generated 0 conversions from $507.73 spent. The biggest movement is the 49.35% week-over-week spike in Google spend with still zero conversions returned, suggesting budget is scaling on a channel that has not yet proven conversion ability and warrants immediate review.

performance.verdict: Google's $507 spend is confirmed waste; Meta CPL holds but pipeline is hollow.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $507.73 over 28 days and returned 0 conversions; 49.35% spend spike last 7d makes this an accelerating leak, not a slow bleed.
5 overdue SOW milestones (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL build gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unverified as complete.
GHL shows 147 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — 140 leads arriving but pipeline is fully stalled; this is an intake/CRM process leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions collapsed 90.48% week-over-week (from ~21 actions to ~2); last 7 series days show 0 GBP actions, suggesting a profile or listing issue.
3-day Meta lead signal (Sep 12–14): 0+0+4 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 9–11): 12+6+4 — a 73% drop in the last window; spend held at ~$85/day, flagging early fatigue.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately — $507.73 spent, 0 conversions over 28 days and worsening; reallocate to Meta.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $507.73 over 28 days with 0 conversions recorded, and the spend rate jumped 49.35% last week with the same zero result. Pause all Google campaigns now and redirect that daily budget (~$18/day) to Meta where all 140 leads originated. Success check: no further Google spend loss by Sep 18; Meta CPL remains at or below $16.01 within 7 days of reallocation.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL pipeline intake: 147 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments signals a broken follow-up or assignment process — audit immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 147 opportunities created and 190 contacts over 28 days, but 0 appointments booked and 0 deals won — leads are arriving and going cold inside the CRM. Audit the lead assignment, automation triggers, and follow-up sequences in GHL this week. Success check: at least 10 appointments booked within 7 days of fix (by Sep 22), confirming the intake path is functional.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta 3-day lead drop (73% decline Sep 9–14 vs prior 3 days) — if trend holds through Sep 18, escalate to creative_refresh.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta leads dropped 73% in the Sep 12–14 window versus the prior 3 days (Sep 9–11), while spend held steady at ~$85/day — a classic early fatigue signal. No action yet; one bad window is not confirmation. Re-check on Sep 18: if leads-per-day remain below 5 with flat spend, escalate to a creative refresh on the top campaign (BWS - July - Call Campaign - Retarget, $582.91 spend).
